description: This file contains implementation of a Vulkan sample base class for graphics rendering, including setup, resource management, and rendering logic, specifically for Android platform integration.

classes.name: SampleBase
classes.description: A class providing Vulkan graphics rendering setup, resource management, and rendering functions for Android platform.

methods.name: CreateBuffer
methods.description: Creates a Vulkan buffer with specified size, usage, and memory properties.

methods.name: CreateImage
methods.description: Creates a Vulkan image with specified dimensions, format, usage, and memory properties.

methods.name: CreateYuvImage
methods.description: Creates a Vulkan YUV image with specific format and layout, including YUV conversion setup.

methods.name: LoadImage
methods.description: Loads image data into a Vulkan image, handling layout transitions and buffer copying.

methods.name: LoadYuvImage
methods.description: Loads YUV image data into a Vulkan image with multiple planes, handling layout transitions.

methods.name: CreateFramebuffer
methods.description: Creates a framebuffer with color and depth attachments for rendering.

methods.name: CreateSwapchain
methods.description: Creates a Vulkan swapchain for presenting images to the Android surface.

methods.name: DestroySwapchain
methods.description: Destroys the current swapchain and its associated resources.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs rendering of a frame, including image acquisition, command buffer submission, and presentation.

methods.name: SetWindow
methods.description: Associates an Android native window with the Vulkan surface and recreates swapchain.

methods.name: RecreateSwapchain
methods.description: Recreates the swapchain, typically after window resize or surface changes.

methods.name: CreateSurface
methods.description: Creates a Vulkan surface for Android window.

methods.name: CleanUpBase
methods.description: Cleans up Vulkan resources before shutdown.

methods.name: StartUpBase
methods.description: Initializes Vulkan instance, physical device, logical device, and related resources.
